name: 26235-eagledecode-llama3b-1gpu
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct as the target, with linborui/sglang-EAGLE-Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct as the EAGLE draft head. The target is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, same weights; the Llama 3.2 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 generated tokens with no spread, and `ignore_eos` is set, so every request runs its full 1024 decode steps.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant on one GPU, drafting 1024-token replies from short prompts with speculative decoding.
launch:
# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, same weights.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The draft head is a float16 checkpoint and the target a bfloat16 one; they are loaded into
# one process and must agree on a dtype, so the target's is used.
dtype: bfloat16

# The draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and sglang gives the DRAFT model the
# TARGET's context length. Left at the target's 131072 the draft's ModelConfig refuses to
# construct. The workload never exceeds ~1600 tokens per request.
context-length: 2048

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: linborui/sglang-EAGLE-Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

prefill-attention-backend: triton
